def git(*a):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','gc.auto=0',*a])

 with open(p,'xb') as f:f.write((json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n').encode());f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
